summary_en: 86,000 shares (1.1% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), ¥220M upper limit, open-market purchase window 19 June – 10 July 2026. Acquired shares may be used for warrant exercise, strategic M&A, or employee/officer stock awards under a future plan, or cancelled. Executed under Articles 156 and 165(3) of the Companies Act and company bylaws Article 7.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Columbia Works Inc. announced on 17 June 2026 that its board has authorized the acquisition of up to 86,000 treasury shares at a maximum aggregate cost of ¥220 million. The purchase window runs from 19 June to 10 July 2026 via open-market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition is undertaken under the Companies Act Articles 156 and 165(3) and company bylaws Article 7. The company states the rationale as enhancing shareholder returns and improving capital efficiency while sustaining value creation above the cost of capital. Acquired shares will be held for potential use in warrant exercises, strategic M&A consideration, or future employee and officer stock incentive plans, or may be cancelled. As of the announcement date, the company held no treasury shares; shares outstanding excluding treasury totalled 7,716,600.
